target.title: fix(minimax): guard music generation SSE JSON.parse against malformed frames
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.ts:266` calls `JSON.parse(json)` on SSE data frames without try/catch. A malformed SSE data frame → unhandled `SyntaxError` → music generation crashes instead of skipping the bad frame.

## Changes

- `extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.ts`: extract `parseMinimaxMusicStreamFrame()` helper that wraps `JSON.parse` with try/catch → throws descriptive `Error("MiniMax music generation returned malformed SSE JSON frame.")` instead of raw `SyntaxError`. Call site in `readStreamingTrack()` catches and `continue`s (skips bad frame), preserving existing behavior.
- `extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.test.ts`: two tests verifying the fix (mocked SSE + real HTTP server)
- `test/_proof_minimax_music_json_guard.mts`: standalone proof script that imports and calls the actual `parseMinimaxMusicStreamFrame()` function directly

This follows the same pattern as merged D4 JSON.parse guard PRs: #97889 (discord), #97973 (matrix), #97999 (twilio), #98073 (signal), #98587 (slack).

Label: bugfix | merge-risk: 🟢 minimal | AI-assisted

## Evidence

### Standalone proof script (L2) — calls the ACTUAL exported function

```
$ node --import tsx test/_proof_minimax_music_json_guard.mts

[1] malformed SSE frame JSON → descriptive Error
  PASS  throws Error (not SyntaxError)
  PASS  message includes "malformed SSE JSON frame"

[2] valid MiniMax music frame → returns correctly
  PASS  no error thrown
  PASS  returns object
  PASS  audio hex preserved
  PASS  base_resp.status_code is 0

[3] empty string → throws Error
  PASS  throws Error for empty string

[4] non-object JSON → parses (type check is caller's responsibility)
  PASS  no error thrown for valid JSON string
  PASS  returns the parsed string value

==================================================
  Passed: 9  Failed: 0  Total: 9
==================================================
```

Before (current main): `JSON.parse("NOT JSON {{{")` → raw `SyntaxError` crashes music generation
After (this PR): `parseMinimaxMusicStreamFrame("NOT JSON {{{")` → descriptive `Error: MiniMax music generation returned malformed SSE JSON frame.`

### Real HTTP server test (L2) — vitest + live node:http server

The test starts a real `node:http` server on `127.0.0.1:0`, serves an SSE stream with `data: NOT JSON {{{` followed by a valid MiniMax audio frame, then calls `generateMusic()` via `postJsonRequest` forwarded to the local server through real `fetch()`.

```
$ MINIMAX_API_KEY=test pnpm exec vitest run extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.test.ts

 ✓ real HTTP server proof: malformed SSE frame → skip, valid audio → decoded
 ✓ skips malformed SSE data frames and processes valid audio frames
 ... (all existing tests pass)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  15 passed (15)
   Duration  48.70s
```

### Negative control (L3)

Stashing the try/catch and reverting to bare `JSON.parse(json)` causes the real-HTTP-server test to fail with unhandled `SyntaxError`, confirming the fix is real and the test is not a tautology.
